findings: PDF 40 left: the heading and opening prayer clause are supported by the image.
PDF 44 right: removed the unsupported definite article before رب. The following angelic-rank line remains uncertain and its confidence was lowered.
PDF 48 left: the catechumen-prayer heading and selected opening clauses are supported by the image.

PDF 49: the selected catechumen dismissal, first faithful prayer, doxology, and second faithful-prayer rubric are supported by the image. The first selected right-surface line begins within a longer manuscript line.
PDF 53 right: corrected الموضوعه by restoring the second visible waw in the petition. The selected offering prayer is supported by the image.
PDF 57: the third-hour prayer excerpt, blessing rubrics, communion-purpose clauses, and commemoration excerpt are supported by the image.
PDF 58 right: the selected commemoration of the departed is supported by the image. The place commemoration was removed from PDF 58 left because it is visibly on PDF 59 left.
PDF 59 left: the place-commemoration rubric and selected clauses remain supported by the image.
PDF 62: the private-prayer rubric and the deacon's cup rubric are supported by the image.

PDF 66: corrected the inside-the-doors prayer to المكمل كل تدبير الاب and the dismissal clause to وخلصنا بما انك صالح ومحب البشر. The closing امين and the exclusion of St Basil are supported by the image.
